body.text: Data and Field Context for Public Library Architecture

Field documentation (Empty chairs in a room) confirms how physical conditions shape Public Library Architecture. You protect your art and culture output when you test under realistic stress instead of ideal lab assumptions.

Start your Public Library Architecture audit this week. Pick one bottleneck in your art and culture workflow, log your current numbers, and test one fix for 14 days. Keep what improves your numbers and drop the rest.
